import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class FlowEdge {
        int from, to, capacity, flow;
        FlowEdge(int from, int to, int capacity, int flow) {
            this.from = from;
            this.to = to;
            this.capacity = capacity;
            this.flow = flow;
        }
    }

    static int gridSize, timeLimit;
    static String[] gridA = new String[30];
    static String[] gridB = new String[30];
    static int[][] distStart = new int[30][30];
    static int[][] distEnd = new int[30][30];
    static int[] directionX = {0, 0, -1, 1};
    static int[] directionY = {1, -1, 0, 0};
    static int[] level = new int[100010];
    static int[] currentPtr = new int[100010];
    static int[] BFSQueue = new int[100010];
    static ArrayList<FlowEdge> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    static ArrayList<Integer>[] adjList = new ArrayList[100010];
    static int zeroPosX, zeroPosY;
    static int sourceNode, sinkNode;

    static void insertEdge(int a, int b, int cap) {
        FlowEdge e1 = new FlowEdge(a, b, cap, 0);
        FlowEdge e2 = new FlowEdge(b, a, 0, 0);
        adjList[a].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(e1);
        adjList[b].add(edges.size());
        edges.add(e2);
    }

    static boolean isValid(int x, int y) {
        return (x >= 0 && x < gridSize && y >= 0 && y < gridSize);
    }

    static void computeDistances1(int x, int y) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{x, y});
        for (int i = 0; i <= 20; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j <= 20; j++)
                distStart[i][j] = (int) 1e9;
        distStart[x][y] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int curX = cur[0], curY = cur[1];
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = curX + directionX[i], ny = curY + directionY[i];
                if (isValid(nx, ny) && distStart[nx][ny] >= 1e9 && gridB[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y') {
                    distStart[nx][ny] = distStart[curX][curY] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static boolean bfsLevel() {
        Arrays.fill(level, -1, 0, gridSize);
        int qh = 0, qt = 0;
        BFSQueue[qt++] = sourceNode;
        level[sourceNode] = 0;
        while (qh < qt && level[sinkNode] == -1) {
            int cur = BFSQueue[qh++];
            for (int idx = 0; idx < adjList[cur].size(); idx++) {
                int eid = adjList[cur].get(idx);
                int dest = edges.get(eid).to;
                if (level[dest] == -1 && edges.get(eid).flow < edges.get(eid).capacity) {
                    BFSQueue[qt++] = dest;
                    level[dest] = level[cur] + 1;
                }
            }
        }
        return level[sinkNode] != -1;
    }

    static int dfsPath(int v, int flow) {
        if (flow == 0) return 0;
        if (v == sinkNode) return flow;
        for (; currentPtr[v] < adjList[v].size(); currentPtr[v]++) {
            int eid = adjList[v].get(currentPtr[v]);
            int dest = edges.get(eid).to;
            if (level[dest] != level[v] + 1) continue;
            int flowSent = dfsPath(dest, Math.min(flow, edges.get(eid).capacity - edges.get(eid).flow));
            if (flowSent != 0) {
                edges.get(eid).flow += flowSent;
                edges.get(eid ^ 1).flow -= flowSent;
                return flowSent;
            }
        }
        return 0;
    }

    static int computeMaxFlow() {
        int totalFlow = 0;
        while (true) {
            if (!bfsLevel()) break;
            Arrays.fill(currentPtr, 0, 0, gridSize);
            while (true) {
                int flowSent = dfsPath(sourceNode, (int) 1e9);
                if (flowSent == 0) break;
                totalFlow += flowSent;
            }
        }
        return totalFlow;
    }

    static void computeDistances2(int startX, int startY) {
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.add(new int[]{startX, startY});
        for (int i = 0; i <= 20; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j <= 20; j++)
                distEnd[i][j] = (int) 1e9;
        distEnd[startX][startY] = 0;
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cur = q.poll();
            int curX = cur[0], curY = cur[1];
            if (distEnd[curX][curY] >= distStart[curX][curY]) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                int nx = curX + directionX[i], ny = curY + directionY[i];
                if (isValid(nx, ny) && distEnd[nx][ny] >= 1e9 && gridA[nx].charAt(ny) != 'Y' && distEnd[curX][curY] + 1 <= distStart[nx][ny]) {
                    distEnd[nx][ny] = distEnd[curX][curY] + 1;
                    q.add(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        gridSize = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        timeLimit = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++)
            gridA[i] = br.readLine();
        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            gridB[i] = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; j++) {
                if (gridB[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    gridB[i] = gridB[i].substring(0, j) + 'Y' + gridB[i].substring(j + 1);
                    gridA[i] = gridA[i].substring(0, j) + 'Y' + gridA[i].substring(j + 1);
                    zeroPosX = i;
                    zeroPosY = j;
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < 100010; i++)
            adjList[i] = new ArrayList<>();

        computeDistances1(zeroPosX, zeroPosY);
        sourceNode = 0;
        sinkNode = 2 * gridSize * gridSize + 1;

        for (int i = 0; i < gridSize; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < gridSize; j++) {
                if (gridA[i].charAt(j) == 'Y') continue;
                int id1 = i * gridSize + j + 1;
                int id2 = gridSize * gridSize + i * gridSize + j + 1;
                insertEdge(sourceNode, id1, gridA[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                insertEdge(id2, sinkNode, gridB[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                computeDistances2(i, j);
                for (int x = 0; x < gridSize; x++) {
                    for (int y = 0; y < gridSize; y++) {
                        if (gridB[x].charAt(y) == 'Y' || distEnd[x][y] > timeLimit) continue;
                        insertEdge(id1, gridSize * gridSize + x * gridSize + y + 1, gridA[i].charAt(j) - '0');
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        gridSize = 2 * gridSize * gridSize + 5;

        System.out.println(computeMaxFlow());
    }
}
